tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: iPhone Home Screen app-icon CONCEPT for the original cozy, mildly sarcastic pixel-art surgery-clinic management game Stitchin' Time.
Output ONE 1024x1024 PNG, a full-bleed OPAQUE SQUARE. Edge-to-edge colored background. NO transparent alpha, NO pre-rounded canvas corners, NO border frame, NO mockup, NO contact sheet.
Art direction studied from the game's existing shaded pixel characters, clinic fixtures, environment sprites, OpeningSequence wordmark and UI tokens. Use hand-placed looking crisp pixel edges, stair-step curves, chunky near-black olive outlines and 2-3 discrete shade levels. Think a carefully drawn 64x64 game icon enlarged exactly 16x with nearest-neighbor. Thick outline about 2 logical pixels, no antialiasing or smooth/vector edges, no gradients, no photographic texture, no fine dithering.
Game palette: near-black olive #232720; deep clinic olive #4c5449; sage #7e8476 and #b6b9aa; warm cream #f0eddd; ivory #faf7e8; neutral warm stone #e0ded0 and #cac8bb; muted silver #999e91. Use 6-10 of those colors, with the approved founder's existing skin and hair tones when a character appears. Do not render hex strings or a palette chart.
Composition: a single strong subject occupies about 70-76% of the square, centered with all important content inside central 80%. Quiet flat background extending to every edge; if shadow is used it is one hard blocky offset shadow. Prioritize unmistakable legibility at 60x60 pixels with broad shapes and minimal internal detail.
Avoid: all real brands, logos, trademarked medical emblems, Star of Life, red-cross emblems, blood, gore, medical wounds, UI chrome, watermark, extra objects, borders, corner masks. No text whatsoever except the exact ST monogram ONLY if explicitly requested as the subject. No full title, labels, numbers or pseudotext.
Design mode: bold object.
Scene/backdrop: flat opaque #666d60, full bleed.
Primary subject: One huge diagonal cream adhesive bandage, pixel-stepped rounded ends on the OBJECT, not the canvas. Sage central pad with a dark seam and three big cream cross stitches. Only four large perforation dots per wing, no tiny holes. Dark outline and offset pixel shadow.
